_comment.balanced: promptVariant: balance complete proofs with decomposition into child theorems.
_comment.proof_first: promptVariant: prioritize a complete proof, prove auxiliary lemmas in the solution file, and create child theorems only as a justified last resort.
_comment.proofOnly: promptVariant: submit complete proofs or certified disproofs of the exact full target negation equally. Prove every helper inside the solution; children/definitions stay empty. Proof: kind=proof, ready=true. Disproof: kind=counterexample, ready=false. Incomplete: kind=proof, ready=false. No sketches or unproved children.
_comment.application: Restart the runner after changing promptVariant. Quota continuations, resumed attempts, and formatting repairs retain their saved assignment; mission research and formatting-only prompts are unchanged.
